title: Gravity and Horizon
author: Beatrix Dunmore
blurb: Theo Delacroix, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
